scope: Retail per-level lighting for the 13 playable maps, copied verbatim from the committed lighting manifests. Nothing is scaled, rounded or interpolated; values the retail data does not serialize are absent and listed in `missing`. A map whose C_LightList hasSun=0 has `sun: null` (the code-only fallback is not substituted). The `lightmap` block is the decoded g_tLightmap DXT5/BC3 texture set (mip 0) with per-texture identity and hashes; it is not a pixel payload. `lightmap.complete` is false on downtown and highrise: the decoded textures are real, and the one g_tLightmap reference outside the set is listed in `lightmap.unsupported` with its material, stream record and byte position (`partial: true`). A draw that binds such a reference has no lightmap and must use its ambient term.
retailRule: diffuse = ((baked * BakedColour) + SkyColour*skyOcc*saturate(n.y*0.5+0.5) + SunColour*saturate(dot(n,sunDir))*sunOcc) * albedo * diffuseIntensity (shader/common/Lighting.h:153-165)

units.angle: degrees in this manifest (serialized values are radians)
units.colour: linear RGB, 0..1 unless stated (no sRGB decode is applied to lighting colours)
units.colourSrgb: none; the environment-settings colours are multiplied directly in the linear shader term
units.lightmap: DXT5/BC3 texels 0..255 at mip 0; the shader decodes .g/.b (SunSkyLightmap) or (.rgb*.a)^2 (RGBLightmapNormalisedGamma) per material effect
units.sh: linear radiance coefficients, coefficient order (x, y, z, constant)
